title: I stare out eggshell framed windows Shelves of unread books glaring Back In disappointment #smallpoems
summary: I stare out eggshell framed windows Shelves of unread books glaring Back In disappointment #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
I stare out
eggshell framed
windows
Shelves of unread
books glaring
Back
In disappointment

#smallpoems
